subject: note: the point is that the justification for suicide on the basis of rationality has to confront the fact that reason cannot peer into death and make any rational assessment. Dead man don’t do discourse.
note: As paradoxical as it might sound, the decision to end one’s life is a requirement of life in order to escape a life of indignity and incarceration, the life of the concentration camp.
